content: Review comments state the problem and the fix in one sentence, address the code rather than the author, and mark anything optional as a nit. Example: "This drops the error from os.Open; wrap it with %w so the caller can match on it."

Commit subjects are lower-case, imperative, and under seventy-two characters, prefixed with a type: feat, fix, docs, chore. The body explains why the change is needed, not what the diff shows. Example: "fix: wrap the error from os.Open so callers can match on it".

Tests are table-driven: a slice of anonymous structs with a name field, iterated with t.Run(tt.name, ...). Each case names the behaviour it pins, not the input it uses. Example: "rejects a widened exported field" rather than "case 3".
